title: Assorted Free Standing Accessorie Towel Stand 49-Inch Solid Brass | 4 Pivoting Swing Arms | Allied Brass
short_title: Assorted Free Standing Accessorie Towel Stand 49-Inch | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade towel storage with an assorted free standing accessorie towel stand featuring 4 pivoting swing arms and solid brass construction. The freestanding design needs no wall mounting, making it easy to place where you need it in the bathroom.

Highlights:
- Four pivoting swing arms help separate towels and maximize hanging space
- Crafted from solid brass for lasting performance
- Heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping
- Felt pad helps protect floors and countertops from scratches
- Offered in multiple designer finish options, including statement colors

Specs:
- Type: Floor standing towel stand with swing arms
- Mounting: Freestanding
- Material: Brass
- Overall size: 49-Inch H x 12-Inch L x 10.5-Inch W
- Weight: 13.6 lb
- Assembly: Required
- Included: Towel stand
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Style notes: Designed to coordinate with traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures.

_previous.description: This elegantly designed free standing swing arm towel stand provides a convenient and stylish space to hang your favorite towels. Towel stand has 4 pivoting arms so that you can maximize your space. Large base is weighted to help prevent tipping. Towel stand is made of the finest solid brass materials so that it will not rust or corrode and is provided with one of our designer lifetime finishes.
